surface.label: Equipment
surface.purpose: Machines on the shop floor: their state, the jobs they run, their journal and schedule

detail.noTelemetry: No telemetry for this machine yet.

machineCreate.label: Register machine
machineCreate.description: Add a machine to the floor. Kind is required; everything else can follow.

machineSave.label: Save machine
machineSave.description: Save changes to a machine’s details.

machineSetState.label: Set machine state
machineSetState.description: Mark a machine as running, idle, in maintenance, in error or offline. Error reports a breakdown: the running slot is released and the order on it is blocked.

logCreate.label: Log machine event
logCreate.description: Record an event in a machine’s log: a repair, a check or a note.

slotCreate.label: Book a slot
slotCreate.description: Reserve a window on a machine, optionally for an order.

machineDelete.label: Remove machine
machineDelete.description: Remove a machine from the floor.
